## capybara-island.png

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original hero island artwork for a cozy capybara idle game.

Scene/backdrop: One complete jade grass island edged by a creamy sandy shore, surrounded by clean pale aqua water with a generous visible water perimeter on all four sides.
Subject and details: A fruit orchard on the left, a tiny terracotta-roof farm cottage toward the upper right, a small timber dock at the bottom, a pond on the right, and several very recognizable adorable brown capybaras relaxing and gardening. Capybaras have broad rectangular snouts, small round ears, sturdy barrel bodies and short legs.
Style/medium: Attractive rounded tactile clay 3D game art, polished miniature diorama.
Composition/framing: Clean readable composition viewed from an elevated three-quarter isometric-like angle; the complete island and dock stay fully in frame.
Lighting/mood: Warm afternoon sunlight with soft shadows, calm and inviting.
Color palette: Jade greens, creamy sand, pale aqua water, warm brown capybaras and terracotta roof.
Constraints: No letters, no text, no typography, no UI, no logos, no watermark. Render one finished landscape image.

## capybara-tangerine.png

Style/medium: Polished rounded tactile clay 3D game art, warm natural brown clay, softly modeled details, friendly calm expression.
Composition/framing: Square, isolated centered character, complete ears and feet in frame, comfortable empty margin around the silhouette.
Lighting/mood: Warm afternoon soft lighting and gentle dimensional shadows, calm and inviting.
Scene/backdrop: Genuinely transparent background with alpha channel; clean isolated silhouette, no floor, no environment.
Constraints: Exactly one capybara, no letters, no text, no UI, no logos, no watermark. Render one finished square image.
